H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H2691: a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H5273: delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative)
H977: properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H2654: properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H8415: an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean watersupply)
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H5387: properly, an exalted one, i.e. a king or sheik; also a rising mist
H1300: lightning; by analogy, a gleam; concretely, a flashing sword
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H5221: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
H4714: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H929: properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H226: a signal (literally or figuratively), as aflag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc.
H4159: a miracle; by implication, a token or omen
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H6547: Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H6099: powerful (specifically, a paw); by implication, numerous
H567: an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes
H1316: Bashan (often with the article), a region East of the Jordan
H4467: dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)
H3667: Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H5159: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H2143: a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H1777: a straight course, i.e. sail direct
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H5162: properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself)
H3701: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
H2091: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H241: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
H238: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen
H637: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H3426: there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection)
H3644: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H7931: to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
